audit.whatIsWrong: The early phase gives Bouncing Bomb's 850 range but neither its cooldown nor Hexplosive Minefield's, so 'you bleed HP every time you walk up' has no timing you can beat.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 and Hexplosive Minefield is 16 flat. At rank 1 that is a six-second poke rhythm — you can walk up on the beat after a thrown bomb rather than never walking up at all.
audit.corrected: Both numbers added to the level 1-3 spike and the early text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike said to force the all-in 'before he finishes Liandry's + Rylai's' with no cooldown gate on the fight itself.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12 and is the single thing that undoes your engage. The item timing matters less than whether the 20-second knockback is available when you flip in.
audit.corrected: First-item spike now gates the all-in on Satchel Charge being down at 20s rank 1 as well as on his item timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says 'shroud his Satchel Charge' in tldr, winCon and a Do card, and the content layer says the shroud lets you 'break his vision'.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is a thrown ground charge detonated on a delay or by recast — it does not select you, so being unselectable inside Twilight Shroud does nothing about it. What the smoke genuinely does is deny him the sight he needs to aim, which is a different instruction: bait the charge, don't try to vanish through it.
audit.corrected: All 'shroud his Satchel' lines rewritten to 'bait his Satchel Charge', and the shroud's contribution restated as breaking his aim.

edits.before: Ziggs' biggest window: with only Q and no Shroud you cannot zone off his Bouncing Bomb (Q) poke or step around his Hexplosive Minefield (E), so you bleed HP every time you walk up to last-hit.
edits.after: Ziggs' biggest window: with only Q and no Shroud you cannot zone off Bouncing Bomb, back every 6s at rank 1, or step around Hexplosive Minefield's 16s zone, so you bleed HP every last-hit.

edits.before: Once Twilight Shroud (W) is up you can vanish in the smoke to dodge an incoming Q and break his vision, walk up under cover, and reset the poke war back toward even.
edits.after: Once Twilight Shroud (W) is up you can vanish in the smoke to break his aim on an incoming bomb, walk up under cover, and reset the poke war back toward even.

edits.before: Rocketbelt or Lich Bane gives the burst to one-combo him off a single E; force the all-in before he finishes Liandry's + Rylai's and kites your return-dash out.
edits.after: Rocketbelt or Lich Bane gives the burst to one-combo him off a single E; force the all-in while Satchel Charge is down, 20s at rank 1, and before Rylai's lands.

edits.before: Use Twilight Shroud (W) to dodge a Bouncing Bomb, then cross the minefield in one motion — repeat mine hits on you deal reduced damage
edits.after: Use Twilight Shroud to break his aim on a Bouncing Bomb, then cross the minefield in one motion — repeat mine hits on you deal reduced damage

edits.before: Ziggs owns the first three levels and you have to accept it — you have only Q with no Shroud and no sustain, so Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 against your 550 and chips you every time you walk up. Do not throw Q as poke from in front of the wave. His Hexplosive Minefield zones the caster minions, but note that successive mines on the same target deal reduced damage, so crossing it in one motion is cheaper than being held off by it. Never flip E at him for a trade — whiff your one gap-closer and Satchel Charge knocks you back out.
edits.after: Ziggs owns the first three levels and you have to accept it — you have only Q with no Shroud and no sustain, so Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 against your 550 and comes back every 6s at rank 1. Do not throw Q as poke from in front of the wave; walk up on the beat after he throws. His Hexplosive Minefield, 16s flat, zones the caster minions, but successive mines on the same target deal reduced damage, so crossing it in one motion is cheaper than being held off. Never flip E at him for a trade — whiff your gap-closer and Satchel Charge knocks you out.

edits.before: You have only Q and no Shroud — Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 to your 550, and Short Fuse arms an empowered auto every time he casts.
edits.after: You have only Q and no Shroud — Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 to your 550 every 6s, and every spell he casts refreshes Short Fuse sooner.

edits.before: Twilight Shroud comes online: vanish to dodge an incoming bomb and break his vision, walking up under cover to reset the poke to even.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud comes online: vanish to break his aim on an incoming bomb, walking up under cover to reset the poke war to even.

edits.before: Shroud his Satchel Charge and burst the gap. Track Satchel Charge before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Bait his Satchel Charge and burst the gap. Track Satchel Charge before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge, 20s at rank 1: matchup-defining — a knockback that doubles as his self-peel escape, so engage when it's down. - Hexplosive Minefield, 16s: repeat mine hits deal less. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A knockback and his self-peel escape, 20s at rank 1. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: He kites you out — survive, then shroud his Satchel Charge and burst the gap. Akali wins the Satchel Charge cooldown windows.
edits.after: He kites you out — survive, then bait his 20s Satchel Charge and burst the gap. Akali wins the Satchel Charge windows.

notes: SAMPLE SIZE: this matchup has 14 games behind its 51.22% figure. That is not zero so I audited it, but the win rate and the level chart should be treated as noise — I made no edits that depend on the number. The one mechanical fix worth applying regardless: the full layer told you to 'shroud his Satchel Charge', and Satchel is a ground-placed charge that never selects you, so unselectability is not the answer — baiting the 20s cooldown is.
